description: Manually verified public publisher articles, link/date/title and cautious editorial summaries. Offline curation only; not live feed or full-text article access.

articles.headline: Dutch banks including ABN AMRO collaborate on the MyCheck identity wallet
articles.summary: ABN AMRO, Rabobank, ASN Bank and partners are developing a Dutch digital identity wallet. Potential operational and client-onboarding implications, not measured earnings impacts.

articles.headline: ABN AMRO pilots AI agents for financial crime prevention
articles.summary: The bank launched a six-month pilot with Wonderful to assess AI agents in financial-crime detection and customer-data workflows, with human oversight.

articles.headline: Dutch Government Plans to Halve ABN Amro Stake to 10.5%
articles.summary: NLFI outlined a plan to reduce the Dutch state's holding from 20.7% to 10.5%, a potential capital-markets and governance development rather than a bank earnings driver.

articles.headline: NatWest is one of Citi's top picks as European bank credit growth holds firm
articles.summary: Citi highlighted ABN AMRO among preferred European lenders, pointing to loan growth and deposit margin pressures across the sector. This is analyst opinion, not an ABN forecast.

articles.headline: ABN AMRO sees Dutch housing market cooling more sharply in 2027
articles.summary: ABN AMRO revised its Dutch house-price-growth expectation for 2027 lower, amid continued mortgage-rate pressure. Relevant to mortgage exposure discussions, not a credit-loss shock.

articles.headline: Infosys to support ABN AMRO’s wider AI rollout
articles.summary: ABN AMRO expanded its technology collaboration with Infosys to support IT modernisation and wider AI deployment. Costs and savings are not quantified in the article.

articles.source: FD Partner Content · ABN AMRO Sector Insights
articles.headline: Kantelpunt 2026: elektrificatie breekt door in wegtransport
articles.summary: ABN AMRO sector analysis describes accelerating truck electrification and energy-grid constraints. Sponsored content, not independent FD editorial reporting.

articles.headline: ABN AMRO explores a partnership for its investment-solutions business
articles.summary: ABN AMRO Investment Solutions is exploring a partnership to strengthen its investment offering. No transaction or valuation is confirmed by this source.

articles.headline: DNB withdraws minimum mortgage risk-weight floor for Dutch banks
articles.summary: A change in Dutch mortgage risk-weight regulation may affect banks' capital calculations; the article alone does not quantify an ABN-specific CET1 effect.

articles.headline: Intesa, ABN Amro Join Stablecoin Push to Blunt Dollar Dominance
articles.summary: ABN AMRO joined a European banking consortium developing a euro stablecoin. This is a strategic payments development, not an immediately measurable P&L impact.

articles.headline: ABN Amro CEO: ‘You don’t want to be a herbivore in a world of carnivores’
articles.summary: An FT interview discusses ABN AMRO's cost restructuring, capital allocation and AI adoption strategy. Older strategy context, not breaking news.
